BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Pathway Power LLC is a U.S. utility-scale solar and battery-storage developer and independent power producer with projects across SPP, MISO and other U.S. power markets. Company and transaction materials describe a multi-gigawatt pipeline spanning 13 states, including the Greenridge hybrid solar-and-storage project in Texas and the Foxtrot battery project in Arkansas. Igneo Infrastructure Partners completed a preferred-equity investment on June 4, 2026 through its North American strategy and discloses joint governance and a board seat; the legal vehicle, ownership percentage and preference economics are not public. Pathway Power Holdings LLC is treated as a same-platform financing issuer, while Greenridge, Foxtrot and other project SPVs remain subordinate assets. Renova's convertible notes had not converted, and Forest Road, Rabobank and AB CarVal were evidenced as lenders rather than current ordinary-equity owners. No later platform sale, Igneo exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.

api.subsector: Distributed generation, community solar, and battery storage
api.description: 38 Degrees North develops, owns, and operates distributed generation, community solar, battery storage, and related sustainable infrastructure assets. Its end markets include communities, development partners, capital providers, utilities, and commercial counterparties seeking distributed clean-energy solutions. The operating model combines development and ownership of physical energy assets with flexible capital partnerships, making it more infrastructure oriented than a software-only platform. Public materials describe a focus on community solar, distributed generation, and storage, and a July 2025 funding announcement stated that the company had raised more than $230 million of corporate growth capital and acquired U.S. Light Energy's 250 MW-plus pipeline. Kimmeridge made a growth equity investment alongside Climate Adaptive Infrastructure in 2025.

milestones.event: 38 Degrees North announced more than $230 million of corporate growth capital and new equity investment from Climate Adaptive Infrastructure and Kimmeridge.
The company also announced completion of the acquisition of U.S. Light Energy, including a pipeline of more than 250 MW of projects.

BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Dames Point Jacksonville LLC is the local operating and concession entity associated with JAXPORT's 158-acre Dames Point container terminal and adjacent intermodal container transfer facility in Jacksonville, Florida. The business handles container, stevedoring, crane, yard and rail-transfer activity for ocean carriers, cargo owners and military users under long-term port rights. Ceres acquired the former TraPac Jacksonville entity in 2022; Macquarie retained the renamed local SPV when the broader Ceres platform was sold to Carrix, then sold the Jacksonville business and assets separately to JAXPORT in November 2023. JAXPORT is the current owner and SSA is the contract operator, not an equity owner.
